source_text:
∆ιὰ τοῦτο πυρὶ λέγεται βαπτίζειν ὁ Χριστὸς, ἐπειδὴ ἐν εἴδει πυρίνων
γλωττῶν ἐπὶ τοὺς ἁγίους αὐτοῦ μαθητὰς τὴν τοῦ Χριστοῦ χάριν ἐξέχεεν, ἢ διὰ τὸ τοῦ
μέλλοντος πυρὸς κολαστικόν.
thought_title: Why Christ is said to baptize with fire
orientation: John of Damascus is explaining why Scripture says Christ baptizes with fire, after having just said the Spirit is God and God is a consuming fire.
pass_a_gloss: Because of this Christ is said to baptize with fire, since in the form of fiery tongues he poured out the grace of Christ upon his holy disciples, or because of the punishing character of the fire to come.

choices.english: in the form of fiery tongues
choices.why: Keeps the literal phrase 'in the form of' and the glossary rendering 'fiery tongues' for the Pentecostal manifestation.

choices.english: he poured out the grace of Christ
choices.why: Preserves the active verb 'poured out' and the exact genitive phrase 'the grace of Christ' from the source.
rejected: he shed the grace of Christ

choices.term: ἢ διὰ τὸ τοῦ μέλλοντος πυρὸς κολαστικόν
choices.english: or because of the punishing character of the fire to come
choices.why: Renders the substantivized adjective κολαστικόν as 'punishing character' to keep the abstract force of the neuter adjective with the article.
rejected: or because of the punishing fire to come
or on account of the punitive nature of the coming fire

choices.why: Standard literal rendering of the inferential phrase, tying this section to the preceding statement about God as consuming fire.

pass_b_english: This is why Christ is said to baptize with fire: because he poured out his grace upon his holy disciples in the form of fiery tongues, or because of the punishing fire to come.

problems.quote: the punishing nature of the fire
problems.why: Same Greek concept rendered two ways; reader may miss identity.

variants.text: the punishing nature of the fire
the punishing character of the fire

problems.quote: the punishing nature of the fire to come
problems.why: Same concept rendered 'nature' then 'character' across parallel sections.
problems.fix: Use one word consistently, e.g. 'nature' in both.

variants.text: the punishing nature of the fire to come
the punishing character of the fire to come

problems.quote: he poured out the grace of Christ upon his holy disciples
problems.why: 'upon' vs 'on' in parallel passages; minor but could confuse close comparison.

variants.text: he poured out the grace of Christ upon his holy disciples
he poured out the grace of Christ on his holy disciples

edits.old: or because of the punishing character of the fire to come.
edits.new: or because of the punishing nature of the fire to come.

edits.old: because he poured out the grace of Christ on his holy disciples
edits.new: because he poured out the grace of Christ upon his holy disciples

fixed: Changed 'character' to 'nature' for consistency with the parallel section.
Changed 'on' to 'upon' for consistency with the parallel passage.

problems.why: Same referent: God's/Christ's grace, but 'his' vs 'of Christ' may confuse.
Is 'punishing' an adjective or a verb? Shifts between attributive and predicative.
problems.fix: Clarify whether 'punishing' modifies 'fire' or describes its action.

variants.text: the punishing nature of the fire to come

problems.why: Awkward for Christ to pour out 'the grace of Christ'; likely means God's grace through Christ.
problems.fix: Change to 'his grace' or 'grace from Christ'.

problems.why: One says 'punishing fire,' the other 'punishing nature of the fire,' a subtle shift.
problems.fix: Use one consistent phrasing across both sections.

variants.text: the punishing nature of the fire to come

problems.quote: he poured out his grace upon his holy disciples
problems.why: 'his grace' vs 'the grace of Christ' may confuse the reader about referent.

variants.text: he poured out his grace upon his holy disciples
he poured out the grace of Christ upon his holy disciples

edits.old: because he poured out the grace of Christ upon his holy disciples
edits.new: because he poured out his grace upon his holy disciples

edits.old: or because of the punishing nature of the fire to come.
edits.new: or because of the punishing fire to come.

fixed: Changed 'the grace of Christ' to 'his grace' to avoid the awkwardness of Christ pouring out the grace of Christ and to standardize the referent.
Changed 'the punishing nature of the fire to come' to 'the punishing fire to come' to use the same phrasing as the literal gloss and avoid the attributive/predicative shift.
